x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.description:
In Article versioning, during checkout attachments of that version is copied over to the cheked out version. But the links to the attachment in article content is not updated to point to the copeid over attachments. It will continue to use old version's attachments, if for some reason users are not able to access old version then the links will be broken to the users with they are not updated to use copied over attachments. This fix script will fix the sysids in the attachment links.
Note: Please choose to run the fixscript in the background if you have so many articles.
x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.name: Fix attachment links on article versions
